name: Colonial Animal Hospital
description: A veterinary hospital in Newtown Square providing wellness and medical care for cats and dogs.

hero.headline: Colonial Animal Hospital
hero.sub: Wellness exams, vaccinations, and medical care for the pets of Newtown Square.

items: Wellness exams and vaccination schedules for cats and dogs
Diagnostic and medical care for sick or injured pets
Guidance on nutrition, weight, and preventive health
Serving Newtown Square and the surrounding area
Wellness-first approach to keep pets out of the sick room
Vaccination schedules tracked visit to visit
Straightforward explanations of any recommended treatment

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Colonial Animal Hospital treats every visit as a chance to catch a problem early, not just react once a pet is already sick.
The team works with owners on the basics -- diet, weight, and vaccination timing -- that keep pets healthier between visits.

items: A wellness visit covers a full exam plus whatever vaccinations are due.
Sick visits get a clear explanation of what is being tested and why.
Follow-up guidance comes home with you, not just in a folder you never open.

feature.heading: Wellness care that catches problems early
feature.text: Routine exams and vaccination tracking are the foundation, so medical visits stay the exception, not the rule.

spotlight.heading: When your pet is actually sick
spotlight.text: Diagnostic visits come with a plain explanation of what is being checked and what the options are.
